_comment: Deterministic FSMA 204 exemption rules (21 CFR 1.1305 / 1.1300). Reviewable data, not code. The engine evaluates a customer's claimed exemptions against these; it NEVER auto-suppresses CTE/KDE checks on a claim — a partial/full exemption is surfaced for human confirmation. Conservative: a claim without supporting evidence is 'not_determined', never 'not_exempt'. v-bump 2026-07-07: full 1.1305(a)-(r) coverage with numeric thresholds ($25k produce 3-yr avg; $250k RFE; <3,000 hens), NSSP shellfish, commingled RAC, written-agreement kill-step conditions, farm-to-school, IMS Grade A cottage cheese (Feb 2026).

exemptions.evidence_required: sales records establishing average annual produce sales of no more than $25,000 (3-year rolling average, 2020 dollars; 21 CFR 1.1305(a)(1)(ii)/(a)(3))
exemptions.decision_note: A qualifying small producer is fully exempt for the food it grows; eligibility must be evidenced.

exemptions.evidence_required: records showing direct sale to consumers
exemptions.decision_note: Food sold by a farm directly to consumers is exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: kill-step / processing records showing the food was changed so it is no longer a listed food
exemptions.decision_note: If a kill step or change removes the food from the FTL, downstream FTL obligations may not apply, but receipt and kill-step records must still be kept. When the kill step/change is applied by a DOWNSTREAM entity, the 1.1305(d)(6) written agreement (signed, dated, renewed every 3 years) is required; the exemption never applies where the next handler is a retail food establishment, restaurant, or consumer.

exemptions.evidence_required: confirmation the commodity is on the FDA rarely-consumed-raw list
exemptions.decision_note: Produce that is rarely consumed raw is exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: product identification showing the food is not on the Food Traceability List
exemptions.decision_note: A food that is not on the FTL is out of scope for these records (not an exemption, a scope determination).

exemptions.evidence_required: confirmation the product is USDA/FSIS-regulated
exemptions.decision_note: Foods regulated by USDA (certain meat, poultry, egg products) are exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: confirmation the entity acts only as a transporter of the food
exemptions.decision_note: Transporters of food are exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: nonprofit food establishment status
exemptions.decision_note: Nonprofit food establishments are exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: entity classification as an RFE or restaurant
exemptions.decision_note: Retail food establishments and restaurants have modified requirements (partial).

exemptions.evidence_required: confirmation of fishing-vessel status before first land-based receiving
exemptions.decision_note: Fishing vessels are partially exempt prior to first land-based receiving.

exemptions.evidence_required: records establishing fewer than 3,000 laying hens (21 CFR 1.1305(a)(2))
exemptions.decision_note: Shell egg producers with fewer than 3,000 laying hens are exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: documentation the farm is not a covered farm under 21 CFR 112.4(a) (1.1305(a)(1)(i))
exemptions.decision_note: Produce farms that are not 'covered farms' under the Produce Safety Rule are exempt - distinct from the sales-based test.

exemptions.evidence_required: records showing the food was produced AND packaged on the farm with packaging intact until the consumer (1.1305(c))
exemptions.decision_note: Food produced and packaged on a farm is exempt when the packaging remains intact to the consumer and label identifies the farm.
conditions: label identifies farm name and address

exemptions.evidence_required: written assurances / records under 21 CFR 112.2(b) (1.1305(d)(1))
exemptions.decision_note: Produce receiving commercial processing that adequately reduces pathogens is exempt from Subpart S subject to the 112.2(b) conditions.

exemptions.evidence_required: records of treatment per 21 CFR 118.1(a)(2) (1.1305(d)(2))
exemptions.decision_note: Shell eggs receiving the prescribed treatment are exempt from subsequent Subpart S requirements.

exemptions.evidence_required: records showing the food was already kill-stepped/changed when received (1.1305(d)(5))
exemptions.decision_note: Food that had already undergone a kill step or FTL-removing change before receipt is exempt in the recipient's hands.

exemptions.evidence_required: a WRITTEN AGREEMENT per 1.1305(d)(6): effective date, printed names and signatures, the kill-step/change commitment, renewed at least every 3 years
exemptions.decision_note: Shipping to an entity that will apply the kill step is only exempt WITH the written agreement; records of the agreement must be maintained. Never applies where the next handler is an RFE, restaurant, or consumer.

exemptions.evidence_required: NSSP tagging/records or compliance with 21 CFR part 123 subpart C and 1240.60 (1.1305(f))
exemptions.decision_note: Raw bivalve molluscan shellfish under the NSSP (or equivalent) are exempt from Subpart S; NSSP tagging records still apply.

exemptions.evidence_required: records establishing the food is a commingled RAC per 1.1305(h) (not fruits/vegetables subject to part 112)
exemptions.decision_note: Commingled raw agricultural commodities (per the rule's definition, excluding produce covered by part 112) are exempt; retailer/RFE recipients still keep source records.

exemptions.evidence_required: sales records establishing average annual food sales of no more than $250,000 (3-year rolling, 1.1305(i))
exemptions.decision_note: Retail food establishments and restaurants at or below the $250,000 average annual monetary value of food sold are fully exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: records of the ad-hoc purchase from another RFE/restaurant (1.1305(k))
exemptions.decision_note: Ad-hoc, occasional purchases by an RFE/restaurant from another RFE/restaurant are exempt for that food.

exemptions.evidence_required: records of the farm-to-school/institution program sale (1.1305(l))
exemptions.decision_note: Certain food sold through farm-to-school / farm-to-institution programs is exempt; the operation still keeps basic source records.

exemptions.evidence_required: n/a - food for personal/on-farm consumption (1.1305(p))
exemptions.decision_note: Food for personal consumption is exempt.

exemptions.evidence_required: records showing the food is held by a business on behalf of a specific consumer (1.1305(q))
exemptions.decision_note: Food held on behalf of specific consumers (e.g. delivery holding) is exempt in that holder's hands.

exemptions.evidence_required: records showing the food is for research or evaluation, not retail sale (1.1305(r))
exemptions.decision_note: Food for research or evaluation use is exempt, subject to labeling/conditions in 1.1305(r).

exemptions.evidence_required: IMS listing (Grade 'A') documentation for the facility producing the cottage cheese (Feb 2026 exemption, eff. 2026-02-20)
exemptions.decision_note: IMS-listed Grade 'A' cottage cheese is exempt from full Subpart S, BUT immediate-previous-source and immediate-subsequent-recipient records must still be kept - a partial carve-out, never a full clearance.
